host.hostContext: User reported PC restarted. Measurement lanes run sequentially without concurrent task builds, tests, or profiling.

protocol: Same methods and sample counts as the prior chart captures; measurement lanes executed sequentially.
commands:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
$env:COMPARISON_SAMPLES='50'
node framework-comparison/src/measure.mjs --correctness-passed --output=docs/performance-baselines/post-restart-2026-09-07-browser.json *> .tmp/post-restart/browser.log
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Browser measurement failed' }
$env:COMPARISON_HEAP_SAMPLES='10'
$env:COMPARISON_HEAP_OUTPUT='docs/performance-baselines/post-restart-2026-09-07-heap.json'
node framework-comparison/src/measure-heap.mjs --correctness-passed *> .tmp/post-restart/heap.log
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Heap measurement failed' }
$env:COMPARISON_SSR_RUNTIMES='node'
$env:COMPARISON_SSR_SAMPLES='500'
$env:COMPARISON_SSR_WARMUPS='100'
$env:COMPARISON_SSR_CONCURRENCY_WAVES='500'
$env:COMPARISON_SSR_MEASUREMENT_ROUND='5'
$env:COMPARISON_SSR_SATURATION_CONCURRENCY='32'
$env:COMPARISON_SSR_SATURATION_WINDOWS='1'
$env:COMPARISON_SSR_SATURATION_WINDOW_MS='1000'
$env:COMPARISON_SSR_ATTRIBUTION_CONCURRENCY='32'
$env:COMPARISON_SSR_ATTRIBUTION_WINDOWS='1'
$env:COMPARISON_SSR_OUTPUT='docs/performance-baselines/post-restart-2026-09-07-ssr.json'
node framework-comparison/src/measure-ssr.mjs --correctness-passed *> .tmp/post-restart/ssr.log
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'SSR diagnostics failed' }
$env:COMPARISON_STARTUP_SAMPLES='30'
$env:COMPARISON_CPU_RATES='1,4,6'
node framework-comparison/src/measure-startup-cpu.mjs --correctness-passed --output=docs/performance-baselines/post-restart-2026-09-07-startup.json *> .tmp/post-restart/startup.log
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Startup measurement failed' }
node .tmp/post-restart/prepare.mjs
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Capacity preparation failed' }
foreach ($captureLane in @('multi','normal','arrivals')) {
 node .tmp/post-restart/capacity-runner.mjs ".tmp/post-restart/$captureLane-plan.json" "docs/performance-baselines/post-restart-2026-09-07-$captureLane.json" *> ".tmp/post-restart/$captureLane.log"
 if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Capacity measurement failed: $captureLane" }
}
